author: Julia Romero
title: North Las Vegas police release video of man armed with scissors during shooting - NewsBreak
text:
By Julia Romero ,
2 hours ago
LAS VEGAS (KLAS) — North Las Vegas police released new video and pictures of a deadly police shooting involving a man “acting erratically” atop a car and armed with scissors following a crash, according to police.
It occurred on April 29, near the intersection of 5th Street and Gowan.
Crash leads to deadly police shooting in North Las Vegas The man involved in the crash was later identified as Khalil Normi Jamal Smith, 31, and was described as “acting in a threatening manner” and reportedly armed with a sharp object, according to police.
When officers arrived at the scene, Smith was seen on the roof of a car “acting erratically,” police said. Officers attempted to get the suspect to comply with their commands, but he did not.
In the video released by police, the man could be heard rambling to police about Jesus Christ, to which officers could be heard asking Smith to drop the object.
The officers asked the suspect to drop the sharp object and get down from the vehicle. Smith then suddenly jumped off the vehicle and ran directly toward an officer while revealing the sharp object in his hand, police said. Two officers, identified as Officer Manuel Moreno and Officer Donnie Miranda, then fired their guns, hitting Smith and knocking him to the ground, police said.
Despite multiple commands by police to stop, stay down, and drop his weapon, Smith repeatedly got up and ran toward the officers while still armed with the sharp object. During each instance, officers continued to fire their guns as Smith continued to pose an immediate threat, police said.
Eventually, Smith was taken into custody by police. During his arrest, Smith bit one of the officers. Smith was then taken to the hospital, where he was later pronounced dead.
Earlier, Smith collided with another vehicle. The occupants of the other car included a woman and her two children; all three were taken to the hospital and treated for minor injuries, police said.
Officer Moreno was hired by the North Las Vegas Police Department in 2023, and Officer Miranda was hired by the North Las Vegas Police Department in 2024. Both officers have been placed on paid administrative leave.
Smith had no prior criminal history before the shooting occurred. Had Smith survived, he would have faced several charges, including attempted murder on a protected person, battery on a protected person, and resisting arrest with the use of a deadly weapon, police said.
This is the first officer-involved shooting involving the North Las Vegas Police Department in 2026.
The North Las Vegas Police Department released the information on the shooting via a pre-recorded video news release; as a result, the media was not offered a question-and-answer period during this latest news release.
